Goal: Run the data plane inside the customer network so databases and records are never exposed to DataX systems.
Business outcome: Unblocks regulated buyers (banks, health, gov). Removes the #1 sales objection.
Key risks: Support burden of customer-run installs; upgrade complexity.

Goal: OpenAI-compatible proxy that tokenises/encrypts PII before any prompt reaches an external LLM and restores it in the reply.
Business outcome: Customers can use cloud LLMs without sending raw PII outside; also routes sensitive prompts to local models.
Key risks: Detection is never 100% (names, context, quasi-identifiers); latency; streaming edge cases.
